w10_T4_001934: A hardware depot has 224 racks in the main hall and 43 more in the annexe. Every rack holds 8 shelves. Each shelf carries 4 boxes, and every box contains 9 bolts. The depot's forklift can lift 900 kilograms. Stock-taking times are recorded on the depot sheets in minutes rather than hours. How many bolts does the depot hold in total?
w10_T4_001936: A ferry company had 212 life jackets in its store. An inspection condemned 17 of them as worn out. Another 42 went down to the small boats at the jetty. The summer fleet then took 144 more out of the store. A repair shop returned 12 jackets it had mended, and a supplier delivered 23 new ones. The ferry carries 180 passengers, and the crew logs its safety drills in minutes rather than hours. How many life jackets are in the store now?
w10_T4_001940: A bakery packs 131 boxes of shortbread on each of 3 shifts. Quality control pulled 31 boxes off the line as underweight. A returned pallet then added 26 boxes back to the stack. A late shift produced another 13 boxes before closing. The bakery's main oven is 4 metres wide. How many boxes are on the stack now?
w10_T4_001943: A youth hostel keeps 217 blankets in its linen room. A school group borrowed 40 of them for the week. Another 36 went to the annexe across the yard. Then 17 blankets were sent away to be repaired. A donation from a hotel added 35 new blankets to the linen room. How many blankets are in the linen room now?
w10_T4_001947: A campsite shop had 61 bundles of firewood and took in 33 more from the forestry yard. Campers bought 24 bundles over the bank holiday. Every bundle still in the shop contains 6 logs. Each log can be split into 8 kindling sticks. The shop prices its wood in cents rather than dollars. How many kindling sticks could the shop's wood produce?
w10_T4_001953: In the morning a dairy filled 77 crates on each of its 5 lines. Just before lunch a partner dairy sent over 7 extra crates. During the afternoon 166 crates were loaded onto the delivery lorries. In the evening the staff counted the crates still in the chiller and confirmed that each one holds 9 bottles. How many bottles are in the chiller?
w10_T4_001955: A jam maker had 14 crates in the shed and sent 8 of them to a farm shop. Every crate still in the shed holds 4 jars. A market stall returned 51 unsold jars to the shed. Customers at the gate then bought 64 jars over the weekend. A new batch added 59 jars to the same shelf. The jars were finally split equally between 2 delivery vans, and the first van set off at once. The shed roof needs 30 new tiles. How many jars went out on the first van?
w10_T4_001956: Ravi counted 194 chairs in the community centre and moved 87 of them into the storeroom. A neighbouring hall then lent the centre 53 chairs for the festival. All the chairs still out on the field were shared equally between 5 marquees. Ravi's colleague Sinead, who had brought fewer chairs than Ravi counted, added 17 from her own van to the first marquee. Rain damage cost that marquee 24 chairs, and a further 5 were carried off to the stage. The centre bills its hire in minutes rather than hours. How many chairs are left in the first marquee?
w10_T4_001959: A print shop bound 18 folders, and each folder held 9 reports. Every report runs to 5 pages. The pages were then shared equally between 5 filing boxes, and the grey box took the first share. A clerk added 79 loose pages to the grey box. A shredder later destroyed 182 pages from that same box. The shop has been binding for a dozen years and quotes its jobs in minutes rather than hours. How many pages are in the grey box?
w10_T4_001963: A tea packer loads 52 pallets onto each of 5 lorries. Every pallet carries 9 cases. Each case holds 4 cartons, and every carton contains 4 boxes of tea. How many boxes of tea leave the packing plant on those lorries?
w10_T4_001967: A florist had 46 buckets of roses and sold 37 of them to a wedding planner. A grower delivered 7 more buckets that afternoon. Every bucket in the shop holds 6 stems. The florist used 93 stems making arrangements for a hotel. A late delivery brought 76 loose stems to the workroom. The shop prices its flowers in cents rather than dollars. How many stems does the florist have?
w10_T4_001970: A publisher stores 136 cartons in the basement and 60 more in the loft. Every carton holds 9 packs. A returned order added 66 loose packs to the same stock. Each pack contains 7 booklets, and a printer sent over 27 spare booklets to go with them. The publisher's office has 22 desks. How many booklets does the publisher hold?
w10_T4_001971: A stationer packed 132 boxes on each of 3 mornings. A wholesaler collected 369 of those boxes during the week. A cancelled order returned 24 boxes to the shelf, and a supplier added 27 more of the same kind. Every box on the shelf contains 7 pencils. The stationer has traded here for a dozen years and lists delivery times in minutes rather than hours. How many pencils are on the shelf?
w10_T4_001972: A market stall opened the morning with 40 trays of eggs, and a farm van delivered 34 more. Before lunch 63 trays were sold to a hotel chef. In the early afternoon a customer returned 9 trays that were surplus to her order. Later that afternoon 10 trays were dropped and ruined. In the evening every tray still on the stall was repacked into 3 small cartons for the late shoppers. The stall pays 45 pounds a day for its pitch. How many small cartons did the repacking produce?
w10_T4_001973: A choir had 133 songbooks and a donor gave it 22 more. The books were shared equally between 5 practice rooms, with the Green room taking the first share. Then 6 of the Green room's books went missing after a concert. A member later brought in 9 books she had found in her car and left them in the Green room. The choir has 48 singers. How many songbooks are in the Green room?
w10_T4_001976: A hotel laundry uses 18 trolleys, and each trolley carries 9 bags. Every bag holds 6 sheets. Each sheet is hung with 5 pegs, and the housekeeper set out exactly that many pegs. She then found 21 more pegs in a drawer and put them out with the others. The laundry has been running for a dozen years. How many pegs are set out altogether?
w10_T4_001981: Hana filled 98 boxes on each of 7 days at the packing shed. Her colleague Bertil, who filled fewer boxes than Hana every single day, added 77 boxes of his own to her stack. A lorry then took 552 boxes from that stack down to the port. A late return brought 10 boxes back to the shed. Hana has worked here for a dozen seasons. How many boxes are on the stack now?
w10_T4_001990: A school ordered 162 exercise books in September, and by November its order for the year had doubled. A separate delivery added 60 more books to the same store. Every book in the store contains 6 sections of squared paper. A supplier then sent 42 loose sections to be pasted into damaged books. The store cupboard sits at the end of the corridor. How many sections of squared paper does the school have?
w10_T4_001994: A cider press filled 94 crates on each of 8 days. A neighbour brought 21 more crates of apples to add to the store. Every crate in the store yields 5 litres of juice. The bottling run then used 3003 litres in a single week. How many litres of juice are left?
w10_T4_001996: A village fete raised 73 pounds on the tombola. The cake stall brought in 80 pounds, and the plant stall added 47 more. A raffle contributed 59 pounds to the same fund. A late donation from the pub added 17 pounds. The fete has been held for a dozen years, and 340 people came through the gate. How many pounds did the fete raise altogether?
w10_T4_002001: Yara packed 32 boxes, and each box held 8 candles. The candles were shared equally between 4 market stalls, and Yara took the first stall's share herself. She dropped 2 of her candles on the way to the pitch. Her friend Tomasz, who had made fewer candles than Yara, gave her 68 of his to sell alongside her own. Every candle on Yara's stall sold for 5 pounds. How many pounds did Yara take?
w10_T4_002007: A garden centre started the morning with 34 sacks of compost and sold 16 of them before ten. At midday a lorry delivered 35 more sacks into the yard. Every sack in the yard holds 9 litres of compost. During the afternoon and evening the landscaping team used 86 litres from the yard. The centre prices its compost in cents rather than dollars. How many litres of compost are left?
w10_T4_002012: In the morning a mill loaded 134 pallets, and each pallet carried 8 sacks. Every sack was found to hold 9 bags of flour. During the afternoon 914 bags were delivered to bakeries around the county. In the evening the staff worked out that each remaining bag makes 8 loaves. The mill's chimney is 30 metres tall. How many loaves could the remaining flour make?
w10_T4_002014: Early in the morning a cannery stacked 155 crates, and each crate held 4 trays. Every tray carries 2 boxes, and each box contains 8 tins. During the afternoon 8201 tins were shipped out to supermarkets. In the evening a returned order added 19 tins back to the store, and a partner factory sent over 66 more. The cannery employs 74 people on the day shift. How many tins are in the store now?
w10_T4_002015: A stables had 87 bales of hay in the barn and bought 14 more from a neighbour. Every bale can be split into 7 hay nets for the horses. Winter feeding used 174 nets from the pile. A riding school then took 25 nets away for its own ponies. The stables looks after a dozen horses and has 19 stalls in the yard. Feed times are written up in minutes rather than hours. How many nets are left?
